title: Unreal Past Conditions: Three Ways
goal: Review si hubiera, hubiera without si and de haber + participle, and add the negative de no haber.
grammar: Three ways to state an unreal past condition

items: I can say an unreal past condition with si hubiera, de haber or hubiera at the start.
I can say it in the negative with de no haber and put pronouns on haber.
I can use the new words for faults and checks.
